reviews.t: Not as good as I thought
reviews.x: I used it twice and that was it.  I thought I would love it as it's such a great idea.  However, I feel as if it's an unnecessary step to get all the brushes clean.  I also have to find a storage for it.  On top of that the brush bristles would get stuck everywhere on the glove.  I tried to get it out and it's impossible.  I would not recommend it or ever get it again.  Good old fashion cleaning with my hand is the best.

reviews.t: I would highly recommend this product
reviews.x: This is not an absolute must have, but it does cut a substantial amount of time from the task of cleaning brushes. I dab a bit of my Kirkland (Costco) brand Shampoo on the glove then swirl around my brushes. If you use your brushes daily, and wash your brushes weekly, I would highly recommend this product.

reviews.t: Love it!!!

reviews.t: Better than first version
reviews.x: Everything is new and improved. However if there was one thing I could change about it, it would be the two thumb feature.. I think the two thumbs idea is just stupid and I honestly can't understand why Sigma would include that rather than just make a left hand glove for left handed people and a right hand glove for right handed people. The two thumbs on the glove makes wearing it so completely awkward. It doesn't feel right.

reviews.t: Works best as a mat; prone to staining/color fading
reviews.x: I've found that this glove works best as a mat. I lay it flat in the sink with the faucet on low, swirl my brushes in the Beauty Blender Cleanser solid cake, then rub them around on the various textures of the cleaning glove until the water rinses clear. It's a little tedious to try and wear it but using it as a mat works well. I've noticed some color fading (from the detergent in the cleanser cake?) and it stains somewhat easily. reviews.t: Must Have!
reviews.x: Great product but packaging left a lot to be desired. I was afraid the item had been used or that there might be a hole in the glove but thank goodness, there was not. The only reason I did not buy directly from Sigma is because they were out of this color. This glove makes cleaning your brushes so much easier, wish I had purchased this item sooner.

reviews.t: The BEST Spa Brush Cleaning Glove
reviews.x: LOVE IT!!! It can be utilized by either hand for both types of cleaning. A left-handed or right-handed person will find is so easy to use when cleaning ANY size cosmetic brush and ANY size beauty blender sponge! Don't wait, it make a great gift too!

reviews.t: This almost makes me enjoy cleaning my brushes
reviews.x: This almost makes me enjoy cleaning my brushes.  I'm impressed with how clean my brushes are when I use this mitt.  I usually listen to everything Wayne Goss (internet make-up star) has to say, but on this mitt, he got it wrong--it's fantastic.

reviews.t: If you are tired of using dirty make-up brushes
reviews.x: If you are tired of using dirty make-up brushes, invest in this mitt.  It has many different type of ridges that you can use to gently clean all your brushes.  It is very well made and should last a lifetime.

reviews.t: Love IT!!!!

reviews.t: Easy, fast
reviews.x: Can't believe I didn't have this product sooner! Easy, fast, and effective while not stripping the bristles at all. No reason for me to allow my brushes to get dirty because it takes less than 10 minutes to clean them all when it used to take me 20 minutes for just the kabuki! Even then it was never completely clean for fear of overworking the bristles that would fall out each time. Amazing!

reviews.t: Great Makeup brush cleaning system.....

reviews.t: The Cleanest my Brushes Have Ever Been!
reviews.x: I absolutely LOVE this product. Cleaning my brushes used to take forever and I could never really get them completely clean. Now that I have this, it takes 1/4 of the time it used to take to clean my make-up brushes and now they are actually clean. I would recommend this product and even plan on buying one for my friends as Christmas gifts.

reviews.t: Really good product
reviews.x: I've purchased a few silicone brush cleaners over the years, but this product worked the best. I did a bunch of research to make sure this wasn't counterfeit. To be on the safe side, if you go to Sigma's website, there is a place where it will take you directly to the approved seller's sites.

reviews.t: Amazing! Speeds up the process of cleaning my brushes
reviews.x: Amazing! Speeds up the process of cleaning my brushes. The ridges and nubs get into the bristles and allow for makeup/soap to rinse away. Helps to get me motivated to actually clean my brushes. Loved it so much, I've started gifting then to my friends.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the glove cleans makeup brushes effectively and deeply, with many calling it a must-have or highly recommending it.
Many reviewers say it saves time and makes brush cleaning easier or even enjoyable.
Some reviewers complain about the price, saying cheaper alternatives work just as well.
A few reviewers find it unnecessary or awkward to use, mentioning bristles getting stuck or preferring to use it flat as a mat.
Some reviewers dislike the two-thumb design or suggest a left-handed version instead.
